abstract: Based on the clinical course of ovarian dysgerminoma with multiple metastatic foci in the lung recurring at 7 years and a half after initial therapy, various problems of diagnosis, treatment, and administration of this tumor were discussed. As to the multiple recurrent foci, complete remission was obtained by 3 courses of combined chemotherapy with cisplatin, adriamycin and cyclophosphamide. Generally speaking, this type of tumor is remarkably sensitive to various kinds of oncostatics, and chemotherapy involving the above chemotherapeutic agents is worth trying in selective cases of advanced or recurrent cases.
abstract_ja: 初回治療から7年半後に多発肺転移をきたして再発した卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の臨床経過に基づき、本腫瘍の診断、治療、投与上の諸問題を検討した。多発再発巣に対し、シスプラチン、アドリアマイシン、シクロホスファミドによる併用化学療法3コースで完全寛解が得られた。一般に、この種の腫瘍は各種の抗腫瘍薬に著しく感受性が高く、進行例または再発例のうち選択された症例では、上記の化学療法レジメンを試みる価値がある。
